calendar_exposure_policy.claim_boundary: Gross elapsed calendar days support whole-protocol comparisons only. They do not identify time under storage, isolate calendar-aging exposure, or exclude time spent in reference tests and documented pauses.
calendar_exposure_policy.rationale: The agreed calendar estimand uses common observed elapsed-time horizons and reference-test schedule is an assigned protocol factor. Net storage exposure remains a distinct unavailable estimand.

longitudinal_observation_policy.rationale: Relative outcomes equal one at baseline by construction. Positive-horizon support ranges define continuous trajectory domains without authorizing extrapolation or assuming valid interpolation.

treatment_evaluation_policy.rationale: Observed treatment combinations may be compared as joint conditions. A one-factor contrast structure records that only one assigned treatment differs; it does not identify an isolated treatment effect because the assignment mechanism is undocumented.

primary.rationale: Primary support requires every assigned cell in a condition to contain eligible observations spanning the reported interval.

sensitivity.rationale: Sensitivity support permits one unavailable cell in a three-cell condition while retaining at least two independent cells.
